about: 회계 II › 계약관리 › 청구예정자료인쇄(E060907, 2026-10-13 원본 실측 — QA회계2-청구인쇄 계약 2 × 40,000 의 청구예정자료 2026/10/13 -4): 출력물 '청구예정자료리스트' 열 □ · 거래처명 · 계약명 · 항목명 · 수량 · 공급가액 · 부가세 · 합계 · 상세, 끝에 합계(앞 세 칸 묶음). 원본은 거래처 하나가 한 줄 — 같은 계약 줄로 두 장(2 · 1 × 40,000)을 만들면 'QA회계2-청구인쇄 외 1건 · 이카운트 사용료 외 1건 · 3.00 · 120,000 · 12,000 · 132,000'. [상세] → '상세청구예정자료리스트' 창의 월/일이 청구생성번호. 청구예정자료를 지우면 빠진다. 만든 자료는 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 준비 — 계약항목 · 계약 · 청구예정자료(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const c='P'+String(Date.now()).slice(-4);const it=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-items',{code:c,name:'QA회계2-인쇄항목',unitPrice:40000,vatIncluded:false,billingCycle:'PERIODIC',salesAccountId:null})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('ciId',it.id);const u=(await window.__api('GET','/billing-contracts/units')).body.find((x)=>x.name==='월말청구');const p=(await window.__api('POST','/partners',{code:'QP'+String(Date.now()).slice(-5),name:'QA회계2-인쇄거래처',type:'CUSTOMER'})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('pId',p.id);const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');sessionStorage.setItem('ymd',ymd);const bc=(await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts',{contractDate:ymd,partnerId:p.id,code:null,name:'QA회계2-청구인쇄',billStart:ymd,billEnd:(d.getFullYear()+1)+ymd.slice(4),vatType:'세금계산서',foreignCurrency:false,employeeId:null,departmentId:null,projectId:null,remark:null,lines:[{itemId:it.id,billMonths:ymd.slice(5,7),quantity:2,unitPrice:40000,supplyAmount:null,vatAmount:null,billingUnitId:u.id,remark:'QA회계2'}]})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('bcId',bc.id);const b=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-bills',{billDate:ymd,vatType:'세금계산서',byPartner:false,lines:[{contractLineId:bc.lines[0].id,billMonth:ymd.slice(0,7),quantity:2,unitPrice:40000,supplyAmount:80000,vatAmount:8000,remark:'QA회계2'}]})).body;const b2=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-bills',{billDate:ymd,vatType:'세금계산서',byPartner:false,lines:[{contractLineId:bc.lines[0].id,billMonth:ymd.slice(0,7),quantity:1,unitPrice:40000,supplyAmount:40000,vatAmount:4000,remark:'QA회계2'}]})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('billId',b[0].id);sessionStorage.setItem('billId2',b2[0].id);sessionStorage.setItem('billNo',b[0].docNo);return b[0].id+' '+b2[0].id})()
